name: dragino-laq4
description: Indoor air quality sensor: TVOC, eCO2, temperature, humidity, battery
caveats: 1) Byte 2 (Alarm Flag & MOD) is OMITTED: it is a bitfield (bit0 = alarm flag, bits 2-6 = MOD) and the grammar has no bitmask support. 2) Layout-switch hazard: frames with MOD=31 (byte2>>2==0x31, reply to an alarm-settings poll downlink) arrive on the same FPort with the same 11-byte length but a different layout; the table would decode them as garbage sensor values. They only occur as replies to an explicit poll, never in periodic operation. 3) Sentinel: TVOC=0 and/or CO2=0 means the device is in calibration (manual notice); the grammar cannot suppress these readings. 4) The co2 field is eCO2 (equivalent CO2 computed from TVOC by the SGP30-class sensor), not a true CO2 measurement — kept as "co2"/ppm for HA carbon_dioxide device class, matching the official decoder's CO2_ppm name. 5) Battery is safe: full 16-bit mV, no status bits masked in the official decoders. 6) Dragino datalog and device-status frames are out of scope per instructions. 7) Vector 3 is constructed (from manual-published byte values) rather than captured, because no full negative-temperature frame is published; derivation shown step by step above.
